decision: Recorded the QR-code-on-receipt idea as a deferred story (S10) in the story map, since it is a deferred user-facing feature and not a binding rule. I didn't implement it, and I didn't change src/receipt.js, which only holds two spacing constants.

recorded.info: Added S10 under 'Deferred (not in the release plan)': a shop can print a QR code on each receipt so customers can leave a review. It is an idea only, not this release and not soon.
